articles.title: Eleven Calls from the Forest
articles.text: A field manager at a remote forest site heard a blast and saw smoke weave between the pines just after sunset. The crew had limited equipment, but their map comprehension was vital because the nearest road curved around a steep ridge. They found that a discarded cigarette had ignited dry leaves near a storage box, something every worker had been taught to hate and prevent. After eleven radio calls, firefighters reached the site and stopped a small accident from becoming a regional disaster.
articles.translation: 日落后不久，一处偏远森林地点的现场经理听到爆响，看见烟雾在松树间穿行。队员的设备有限，但读图能力至关重要，因为最近的道路绕过一条陡峭山脊。他们发现一支被丢弃的香烟点燃了储物箱附近的干叶；每个工人都受过训练，要厌恶并防止这种行为。经过十一次无线电联络，消防员到达现场，阻止了一场小事故演变成区域灾难。

articles.title: Why Dosage Instructions Need Precision
articles.text: A new medicine label must inform patients exactly how much liquid to take, because a line marking eleven millilitres is not the same as a full spoon. The stated volume should cover children and adults separately, with no assumption that body size follows a simple rule. Outside a hospital, clear wording matters as much as it does on a naval vessel or at an isolated forest station. An executive may approve the package, but pharmacists and patients should test whether ordinary readers can understand it under pressure.
articles.translation: 新药标签必须准确告知患者服用多少液体，因为十一毫升的刻线不等于满满一勺。标明的剂量应分别涵盖儿童和成人，不能假定体型遵循简单规则。在医院之外，清楚的说明同样重要，无论是在军舰上还是偏远森林站。管理人员可以批准包装，但药师和患者应测试普通读者能否在压力下理解说明。

articles.title: Smoke-Free Entrances Are Reasonable
articles.text: A gentle sign saying hello should invite visitors into a building, not force them through cigarette smoke beside the door. Smoke-free entrances should become a universal rule for schools, clinics, and even a neighborhood laundry. The policy is not a claim that smokers are wicked; it simply recognizes that others may lose clean air during the first forty steps of a visit. A marked smoking area will probably work better than punishment, and a review each May can reveal whether the arrangement remains fair.
articles.translation: 写着“你好”的温和标牌应欢迎访客进入建筑，而不是迫使他们穿过门口的烟雾。无烟入口应成为学校、诊所乃至社区洗衣店的普遍规则。这项政策不是说吸烟者邪恶，而只是承认其他人可能在进门的前四十步失去清洁空气。划定吸烟区可能比惩罚更有效，每年五月进行审查则能看出安排是否仍然公平。
